item.title: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring as Rams' injuries mount
item.description: Adams suffered the injury in the Rams' loss to the Cardinals. Poona Ford ruptured his triceps and will be out for the season.
item.media:description: Davante Adams leads the Rams with 480 receiving yards and four receiving touchdowns this season.

item.title: After firing GM Chris Ballard, the Colts should now embrace a full rebuild
item.description: After firing its GM, Indianapolis should have a fire sale at the trade deadline to acquire draft capital and position itself for the future.
item.media:description: The Colts could use the Nov. 10 trade deadline to start positioning themselves for the future.

item.title: Texans WR Tank Dell to return vs. Giants nearly 2 years after devastating knee injury
item.description: Dell dislocated his left knee and tore three ligaments with meniscus damage in December 2024.
item.media:description: Texans wide receiver Tank Dell is expected to return Sunday against the Giants after missing nearly two years with a serious left knee injury suffered in December 2024.

item.title: Sean Payton is sticking with Bo Nix. Will improving ‘finer things’ jolt Broncos QB?
item.description: Denver is 4-2, but the offense has been among the league's worst in several categories as the third-year QB struggles.
item.media:description: Sean Payton says the team is giving no consideration to benching Bo Nix.
